[3] A lot of his damage and crowd control relies on proper setup, prediction, and enemies walking into his W zones.
[3] Without his ultimate available, Echo loses a huge amount of his safety, escape potential, and ability to play aggressively.
[3] Once you unlock level six, your map pressure becomes much more dangerous. After pushing waves, constantly look around the map for opportunities.
[3] You also become much stronger once you start pushing waves into tower because it gives you more freedom to roam, control vision, and threaten fights from unexpected angles.
[3] Control wards, brushes, fog of war, and hidden W setups become massive tools for creating picks and forcing mistakes.
[3] Normally, enemies can see your shadow following behind you, which reveals exactly where your ultimate will return.
